columns.name: CASE_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier for each case

columns.name: CASE_PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier for each person associated with a case

columns.name: PRIMARY_CHARGE
columns.description: A flag for the top charge, usually the way the case is referred to

columns.name: CHARGE_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier for each charge filed

columns.name: CHARGE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier for each version of a charge associated with charges filed

columns.name: OFFENSE_TITLE
columns.description: The specific title of the charge offense

columns.name: CHAPTER
columns.description: The legal chapter for the charge

columns.name: ACT
columns.description: The legal act for the charge

columns.name: SECTION
columns.description: The legal section for the charge

columns.name: CLASS
columns.description: The legal class of the charge

columns.name: AOIC
columns.description: Administrative Office of the Illinois Courts ID for law of the charge

columns.name: DISPO_DATE
columns.description: The date the charge was disposed of

columns.name: CHARGE_DISPOSITION
columns.description: The result of the charge

columns.name: CHARGE_DISPOSITION_REASON
columns.description: Additional information about the result of the charge

columns.name: JUDGE
columns.description: Judge who oversaw the case

columns.name: COURT_NAME
columns.description: The Circuit Court District the charge was disposed of in

columns.name: COURT_FACILITY
columns.description: The courthouse the charge was disposed of in

columns.name: AGE_AT_INCIDENT
columns.description: Recorded age at the time of the incident

columns.name: GENDER
columns.description: Recorded gender of the defendant

columns.name: RACE
columns.description: Recorded race of the defendant

columns.name: OFFENSE_TYPE
columns.description: Broad offense type for charges filed in plain language

columns.name: INCIDENT_BEGIN_DATE
columns.description: Date of when the incident began

columns.name: INCIDENT_END_DATE
columns.description: Date of when the incident ended (this will be blank for incidents that did not go more than one day)

columns.name: ARREST_DATE
columns.description: Date and time of arrest

columns.name: LAW_ENFORCEMENT_AGENCY
columns.description: Law enforcement agency associated with the arrest

columns.name: UNIT
columns.description: The law enforcement unit associated with the arrest

columns.name: INCIDENT_CITY
columns.description: The city where the incident took place

columns.name: RECEIVED_DATE
columns.description: Date when felony review received the case

columns.name: ARRAIGNMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date of the arraignment
